Пунктир — сколько энергии попросит сеть: Dashed line — how much power the grid will ask for this shift; green line — how much you gave. Yellow mark — now. Get ready for turns in advance.
Сколько пара пускаем на турбину. Больше: How much steam goes to the turbine. More steam — more power, and the water returns to the reactor colder.
Больше пара на турбину. Реактор сам приб: More steam to the turbine. The reactor raises power by itself: the water returns colder.
Сила пара в парогенераторах. Если вода в: Steam strength in the steam generators. If the reactor water cools, the steam weakens and the valve gives less power.
Резервные электростанции на солярке. Даю: Backup power plants running on diesel fuel. They power the pumps when off-site power is lost. About 10 seconds to spin up.
Спросить, что происходит. Палыч коротко: Ask what's going on. Palych will briefly explain what's happening at the plant, what to do, and where to look.
Три регулятора: общая громкость, станция: Three knobs: master volume, plant (background, machines, processes) and separately alarms and panel. Kept between shifts.
Дать знать, что сигнал замечен: мигающие: Signal that you've seen the alarm: flashing windows go steady and fall silent. They stay lit until the cause clears.
Путь энергии: реактор греет воду, в паро: Path of energy: the reactor heats water, the steam generator turns water into steam, steam spins the turbine, the generator gives the city power.
Посёлок за станцией: котельная, водонапо: The town beyond the plant: boiler house, water tower, school, hospital. Lights in windows and streets are the power the plant sends to the grid: every hundred megawatts — one more block.
Слева — что сейчас и что нужно. «Ниже —: Left — what it is now and what's needed. “Low — on target — high” shows where the value went. Lamps brighten while the condition holds; leave the band and they slowly fade. “On target” green — all good; amber — inside the band, but the second condition is broken.

Это мощность реактора: сейчас 1 %, он по: This is reactor power: 1 % now, it’s almost asleep. Tonight we bring it up to 20 %.
Задание на смену — вот оно: мощность 20: Here’s the shift task: power 20 %, hold for 30 seconds. While you hold, the lamps light up. All ten — shift done.
Стержни глушат реакцию. Нажми «Вверх» —: Rods dampen the reaction. Press “Up” — short, just once.
Смотри на «Разгон»: стрелка ушла вправо: Watch the “Rate” gauge: the needle went right — the reaction is speeding up. Power won’t catch up at once. Pressed — now wait.
Самописец пишет мощность за последнюю ми: The chart recorder writes power for the last minute. Green band — where you need to be, the line — where the reactor is. The slope shows where it’s heading.
Вот, попал. Лампы пошли — теперь не дёрг: There, you’re on. Lamps are going — now don’t twitch.
Сегодня ввели в работу насосы. Каждый ун: Today the pumps went into service. Each carries off heat for about 25 % power. One is running now — start the second.
А это вода на выходе из реактора. Пока с: And this is outlet water from the reactor. While the needle is in the green zone, the pumps are coping.
Вторая лента пишет воду на выходе. Пока: The second chart writes outlet water. While the line is in the green band, the pumps are coping.
Сегодня ввели клапан турбины. Пока он за: Today the turbine valve went into service. While it’s closed, steam bypasses the turbine into the condenser. “Open” — and steam goes to the blades.
Генератор показывает, сколько мегаватт с: The generator shows how many megawatts the station sends to the grid. We need 600. Open the valve bit by bit — the reactor will follow.
Новая лента — генератор. Держи линию в к: New chart — the generator. Keep the line in the band around the dashes: the dashes are the dispatcher setpoint.
Новый прибор — давление в контуре. Вода: New gauge — primary pressure. Water is squeezed to 16 MPa, so it doesn’t boil. “Heaters” raise pressure, “Spray” lowers it.
Бор растворён в воде и тоже глушит реакц: Boron is dissolved in the water and dampens the reaction too — slowly, but across the whole reactor. “Add” — weaker reaction, “Dilute” — stronger.
The rods’ working band — this strip here. Below it the rods are too deep: add boron and raise them bit by bit — in turns.
Сети нет — насосы стоят. Дизель-генерато: No grid — the pumps are down. Diesel generators are the station’s backup power: “Start DG”, and in a few seconds they’ll carry two pumps.
Дизели разгоняются. Как только загорятся: The diesels are spinning up. Once they light up — start two pumps.
Новый прибор — ксенон. После остановки е: New gauge — xenon. After a shutdown there’s a lot of it in the reactor, and it “poisons” the reaction. That’s why the rods are almost at the top and the reactor won’t go.
Разбавь бор понемногу или подожди, пока: Dilute boron bit by bit, or wait for the xenon to decay. And watch the “Rate” gauge.
Посмотри в окно. Свет в посёлке — теперь: Look out the window. The lights in town are on you now.
По-настоящему у ВВЭР есть гермооболочка,: A real VVER has a containment, and it doesn’t blow up like this. What you see here is something else: what the protection system guarded you from every shift.
Holding. Let’s hand over the shift.
